description: RbNaTi₂(PO₅)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. Rb is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 2.85-3.23 Å. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.96 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-49°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-2.15 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-49°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.08 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-52°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-50°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.56 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, and two Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, and two Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Ti, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, one Ti, and one P atom.
